default.title: CRM gateway and controlled reporting workbooks
default.summary: ClawPilot adds a tenant-scoped SuiteCRM gateway, makes Organizations, Contacts, and Interactions manageable in the app, and turns each pipeline workbook into a protected opportunity input and CRM reporting surface.
features: A CRM workspace for Organizations, Contacts, Opportunities, and Interactions scoped to the selected user pipeline
A SuiteCRM OAuth gateway with durable Postgres projections and retriable CRM and Google outboxes
Eight-tab managed workbooks with protected CRM projections, calculations, dashboard reporting, and stable record identities
Direct workbook access from Pipeline and CRM through each pipeline's private eigenracing.com short link
fixes: Stopped treating Organizations and Contacts workbook tabs as independent writable CRM sources
Protected every generated workbook tab and limited operator edits to Opportunities rows
Added stable source identities so opportunity row movement does not create duplicate CRM records after projection
Separated SuiteCRM records, worker leases, and reporting refreshes into independently retriable operations
Preserved the source workbook and raw row payloads for additive migration and reconciliation
